Campaigns & Broadcasts
One record

CAMPAIGNS & BROADCASTS

One send, every channel, one number for what it sold.

A broadcast that ignores opt-outs is a ban risk. A campaign with no attribution is a guess about what worked. Jwero sends consent-aware broadcasts across WhatsApp, email, SMS and push, then wraps them in campaigns that report what each one actually sold.

What does Jwero’s jewellery marketing software do?

Send consent-aware broadcasts across WhatsApp, email, SMS and push to any segment, then see exactly what each campaign sold, attributed to the send. It is part of Jwero One: ₹18,000 a month, every module included, with the first month at ₹3,600.

BROADCASTS

Any audience

See segmentation →

Four channels

WhatsApp, email, SMS and push from one broadcast, no separate tool per channel.

Template-linked WhatsApp

WhatsApp sends link to approved templates, the same discipline that keeps the rest of Jwero’s WhatsApp use out of ban-risk territory.

Consent-aware delivery

A send automatically skips anyone opted out, on DND, or missing a required template, with a structured, visible skip reason, not a silent drop.

CAMPAIGNS

What it sold, not just what it sent.

Wraps broadcasts and journeys

A campaign is a container: one or more broadcasts and journeys, organised around one goal.

UTM-based attribution

Every campaign carries UTM tracking through to the sale, so revenue rolls up to the send that drove it.

Real reporting

See what a campaign actually sold, attributed to the campaign, rather than an open-rate proxy for revenue.

AI campaign-strategist

Give it a brief and it drafts a campaign plan, audience, angles, timing. A person still builds and sends it; nothing ships on its own.

BECAUSE IT'S ONE SYSTEM

  • Broadcasts and journeys share the same channel router and the same consent state, an opt-out recorded anywhere is honoured everywhere.
  • Campaign audiences are built from the same segments, groups and tags Jwero uses for journeys, no separate list to export and re-upload.
  • A campaign can target a loyalty tier directly, because loyalty tier already lives on the same customer record campaigns read from.

CAMPAIGN QUESTIONS

Consent, attribution, and what the AI can touch.

Does a broadcast risk sending to someone who opted out?

No, delivery automatically skips anyone opted out, on DND, or missing a required template, with a structured skip reason recorded.

Does the AI campaign-strategist send campaigns by itself?

No. It drafts a plan from a brief; a person still reviews, builds and sends it, the same "AI drafts, human approves" rule used across Jwero.

More questions jewellers ask.

How do jewellers send WhatsApp broadcasts without getting banned?

Send through the official WhatsApp Business API using approved templates, only to people who agreed, and honour opt-outs. Jwero skips anyone who opted out and shows why, which is what keeps a number safe.

Do push notifications work for jewellery stores?

They work for visitors who opted in on your website or app: a new collection, a rate drop, a scheme reminder. They cost nothing per message, and go out from the same campaign as WhatsApp and email.

Does SMS marketing still work for jewellers?

SMS is best for short, certain messages such as payment received, order ready or instalment due. For offers, WhatsApp usually gets more response. Both can go out from one campaign.
